_comment: E-ink tags (MindReset Dot. Quote/0, 296x152 black and white), drawn and sent by dot_service (scripts/ctl dot). Hot-reloaded. Each tag shows its room's mode with Auto, Mic and AI (filled = on), then what is playing, else (live) what the room hears, the scene and the feel, else today's art: art.theme is a scheduler variable of the room's group (quoted: true takes its first 'quoted' phrase, else the 'else' variable), art.style another. refresh_s: how often it is redrawn while a screen of the room is live / otherwise (status changes go at once); the tag's wake interval follows it. sleep: the tag's nightly sleep window (local time). hint: the line along the bottom while no screen of the room is live, telling whoever picks the tag up how to use the room. qr: a QR code (bottom right) any phone camera opens, no app; module_px = pixels per QR module (2 = 58 px for this URL). link = where a phone tap goes (via the Dot. App / App Clip). The Dot. API key is in ~/.config/screen-machine/dot.json, never here.
